verdict.rationale: Glama offers a built-in multi-model chat (glama.ai/chat) where users can ask questions, compare model answers, upload documents, and get instant answers — a lightweight AI assistant surface — but there's no evidence of it autonomously executing multi-step tasks or acting as an agent (e.g., invoking MCP tools, running workflows) rather than just chatting/comparing responses. Missing for 10: evidence of task delegation/execution capabilities (tool use, workflow automation) by the chat assistant itself, and independent corroboration of its agentic behavior beyond a chat UI.
